name: Boost
author: David JM
description: Limit or lift your CPU's max boost clock straight from the bar. Left-click opens a slider with quick presets found in the popup; every change applies live to all cores and is re-applied on the next boot.

barWidget.description: A bolt glyph showing the current max boost cap. Left-click opens a continuous slider (1.0–5.0 GHz) plus preset chips — BASE, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, MAX — and live package temperature. Changes apply immediately to every core via a passwordless polkit helper and persist across reboots (re-applied at boot by cpu-cap-boost.service). Right-click cycles the same presets on the fly; middle-click re-syncs the readout with sysfs.

schema.label: Max boost (GHz)
schema.description: Max boost cap. Set live with the popup slider (any 1.0–5.0 GHz value); the last-applied value is persisted and re-applied by the cpu-cap-boost.service systemd unit on boot.
